priya: Quick sync — finalizing panel for the Senior Infra candidate next Wed 3/12. Need attendees, a scribe, and someone to own the debrief (send within 30m). Proposed time: 9:30 PT / 17:30 GMT / 02:30 SGT. Who can take that slot?

samir: I can take the debrief lead + infra design questions if that helps. 9:30 PT ok but slightly prefer 10a PT if we can shift.

maya_k: I'm blocked 11-12 PT that day. Could do scribe for the first half (9:30-10:30 PT) if needed. Quick rubric q: how are we weighting system design vs debugging?

jordan: I can swap with Samir for 9:30 and/or be scribe. Happy to cover scribe if Maya is partial. Also +1 on rubric clarification — are we on the new rubric?

priya: Use the new 2025 panel rubric unless flagged. Debrief form here: https://redwood.co/debriefs/form?id=infra-sr (please use). Default weights: technical 60%, design 25%, collaboration/communication 15%.

maya_k: Thanks — noted. Also: candidate asked about recording. Do we have consent captured?

recruiter_bot: Calendar invites sent to panel. Candidate consent captured via intake form. :white_check_mark:

priya: Great. Assigning scribe owner — @jordan if you can scribe please confirm. Also need someone to own sending the debrief within 30m post-interview.

jordan: Confirmed. I'll scribe and send the debrief within 30m. Will use this short template:
```
Summary:
Strengths:
Concerns:
Score (1-5):
```

aisha: Quick operational ask — for the live coding piece, do we allow them to use an online REPL (repl.it / codesandbox)? Any bandwidth concerns?

samir: Yes allow remote coding. If network is flaky, fallback to whiteboard/design prompt. Keep live coding to 15m.

priya: Final checklist: scribe = Jordan, debrief lead = Samir, recording consent done, rubric weights default. @maya_k can you confirm availability for the first hour (9:30-10:30 PT)?

maya_k: I can join 9:30-10:30 PT and will focus on design Qs and sync notes. :thumbsup:

priya: Perfect. I’ll update the calendar with the confirmed owners and post a 1-paragraph pre-read in the panel thread tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone.

jordan: Added pre-read note and pasted candidate resume + take-home link in the thread.

priya: Thanks :rocket:
